mapper.select: SELECT B.finprod_id finprodId, finval.total_value vTotalNetVal, DATE_FORMAT(finval.val_date, '%Y%m%d') valDate FROM fin_product_valuation finval, fin_product B WHERE finval.val_date = (SELECT MAX(val2.val_date) FROM fin_product_valuation val2 WHERE DATE_FORMAT(val2.val_date, '%Y%m%d') <= #{vDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and val2.finprod_id = finval.finprod_id) and B.finprod_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND finval.finprod_id = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND finval.FINPROD_TYPE2 = B.FINPROD_TYPE2 group by finval.total_value, finval.val_date, B.finprod_id
